Miss Sau (莎 ) took off her clothing and put
on her night dress. While reclining, she brought a
little book from under the pillow, and commenced to read.
"She tried to evade him, because she saw that his
eyes had become red and his face had lost its kindly
expression. His action seemed to be that of an angry
beast of the jungle.
"But besides a bath room, there was no place to
which she could escape. While she was moving towards
the bed, he suddenly swooped down upon her. He embraced
her with great force.
"She felt his two hot lips coming into contact
with hers. The tip of his tongue was in her mouth.
Their breathing was heavy and they were infatuated with
each other.
"They remained in this position for some time. He
then helped her, freshly bathed, to the bed. At this time,
her cheeks were hot and she was infatuated. She had lost
all powers of resistance.
"When he had helped her to the bed, a pair of ivory
legs appeared from under **〔此处转录不清〕** her gown. Stimulated and
in a desperate hurry to satisfy his desire, he pulled off
her gown and discovered the 'mysterious relic of the
human being.' He saw that a thinly clothed 'Venus' was
before him.

莎小姐（Miss Sau）脱下衣服，换上睡衣。斜躺时，她从枕头下拿出一本小书，开始阅读。“她试图躲避他，因为她看到他的眼睛变红了，脸上失去了温和的表情。他的举动就像一头愤怒的丛林野兽。
“但除了浴室，她无处可逃。当她向床边移动时，他突然向她扑去。他用力拥抱她。
“她感觉到他两片滚烫的嘴唇与她的接触。他的舌尖进入了她的口中。他们的呼吸沉重，彼此痴迷。
“他们保持这个姿势一段时间。然后他帮助刚沐浴过的她上床。此时，她的脸颊发烫，神情痴迷。她失去了所有抵抗力。
“当他扶她上床时，一双象牙般的腿从**〔此处转录不清〕**她的袍子下露出。受到刺激并急于满足欲望，他扯下她的袍子，发现了‘人类的神秘遗迹’。他看到一个衣着单薄的‘维纳斯’就在眼前。

"At this moment, a pair of snow white arms came
into view. Continuing to loosen her gown, he also saw
two crescent-shaped, ivory-colored, a little soft but
protruding breasts coming to view.

"While he was groping, she inclined her body
in order to facilitate his work of loosening her clothing.
Gradually, the path to the "Curves" which is the source
of mankind and the cause of the downfall of men appeared.
Although the place is not large, it is a "mysterious pond"
which defies all efforts at being filled.

"Under the circumstances, he became bewitched
and mad. He hurriedly took off his own clothes and got
into the bed."

Miss Sau stopped at this point, for she was
unable to read further. She seemed to see many stars
moving before her eyes and with the stars a group of
ghosts were dancing. She felt very tired and in the
reclining position dozed for a while.

Awakening, she replaced the book under the
pillow and then lay down to sleep. Feeling one of her
legs itching, she put down her hand to scratch it. While
doing so, she felt that one "certain spot" was moistened.
Her heart was beating heavily and her face grew hot. After
a period of excitement, she fell asleep.

On the following morning, Miss Sau did not get
up until 10 o'clock. She took a bath. The time she took
for the bath was nearly one hour and a half.

We do not know what she did in the bath room
for such a long time, but we know that the time she took
was much longer than formerly. Maybe, Miss Sau's body
was dirty.

“此刻，一双雪白的胳膊映入眼帘。继续松开她的袍子，他还看到两个新月形、象牙色、略显柔软但突出的乳房显露出来。

“当他摸索时，她倾斜身体以方便他解开衣物的工作。渐渐地，作为人类源泉和男人堕落原因的‘曲线’之路出现了。虽然地方不大，但它是一个‘神秘的池塘’，无论如何努力都无法填满。

“在这种情况下，他变得着迷且疯狂。他匆忙脱下自己的衣服，钻进了被窝。”

莎小姐读到这里停了下来，因为她无法再读下去。她似乎看到许多星星在眼前移动，随着星星还有一群鬼魂在跳舞。她感到非常疲倦，以斜躺的姿势打了一会儿盹。

醒来后，她把书放回枕头下，然后躺下睡觉。感到一条腿发痒，她伸手去抓。在做这个动作时，她感觉到某个“特定部位”湿润了。她的心剧烈跳动，脸也变热了。经过一阵兴奋后，她睡着了。

第二天早上，莎小姐直到10点才起床。她洗了个澡。洗澡花费的时间将近一个半小时。

我们不知道她在浴室里这么久做了什么，但我们知道她花费的时间比以前长得多。也许，莎小姐的身体很脏。

Siao Loh (小罗) knew that after the
guests had taken supper, Ah San (阿三) would invite
them to visit some places of amusements. So he went
upstairs with Ah San's wife.

When they were upstairs, Ah San's wife
embraced Siao Loh and lay down on the bed with him.
She then asked, "Were you afraid a few minutes ago?
I feared you might have suffered a shock. Really up
to now, our love has been platonic. Should Ah San
have seen us together, how could we exonerate ourselves
from blame?"

Siao Loh moved his body and with his hand
doing the same 'old trick,' answered, "Why, yesterday
evening, you were too careful. He has returned to-day.
I don't know when we can________"

Until this moment, Ah San's wife lay on her
back, her face red. Suddenly, she closed her two
legs, and eyeing Siao Loh reproachfully, grumbled, "Don't
act in this manner. I am unable to bear it. Although
I have felt no pain now, I have not yet entirely recovered."

"That's why I sent my 'van-guard' (meaning
the hand) first," retorted Siao Loh. "When Ah San
comes back, you should tell him you cannot even move
in order to persuade him to go to sleep with the widow.
We can then attain our object."

小罗（Siao Loh）知道客人们吃完晚饭后，阿三（Ah San）会邀请他们去一些娱乐场所。于是他随阿三的妻子上了楼。

到了楼上，阿三的妻子拥抱小罗，并与他一起躺在床上。然后她问道：“刚才你害怕吗？我担心你可能会受惊。真的，到目前为止，我们的爱一直是柏拉图式的。如果阿三看到我们要在一起，我们怎么能摆脱指责呢？”

小罗挪动身体，用手做着同样的‘老把戏’，回答道：“为什么，昨天晚上你太小心了。他今天回来了。我不知道我们什么时候能________”

直到这一刻，阿三的妻子仰面躺着，满脸通红。突然，她夹紧双腿，责备地看着小罗，嘟囔道：“别这样行事。我受不了。虽然我现在感觉不到疼痛，但我还没有完全恢复。”

“这就是为什么我先派出我的‘先锋’（意指手），”小罗反驳道。“当阿三回来时，你应该告诉他你连动都动不了，以此劝他去和那个寡妇睡觉。这样我们就能达到目的。”

"It is not practicable," answered Ah San's
wife. "because if he goes to sleep with the widow
he will return early in the morning, and we cannot
enjoy ourselves then. Moreover, after you have
exhausted yourself, I'm afraid you will catch cold
when you are compelled to leave me in the early
morning. The plan is not workable."

As he was paying his undivided attention to
his hand, Siao Loh only murmured in reply to Ah San's
wife. For some while, silence reigned in the room.
Heaving a sigh, Ah San's wife broke the silence. "It
is all due to you that I have been disabled to such an
extent as not to be able to move. Now you become
impatient again at this hour. Didn't we sleep together
last night?"

While cleaning his hand with the bed curtain,
Siao Loh smiled and answered.

由于全神贯注于他的手，小罗只是对阿三的妻子低声回应。房间里沉默了一会儿。阿三的妻子叹了口气，打破了沉默。“都是因为你，我才残疾到这种动弹不得的地步。现在这个时候你又变得不耐烦了。昨晚我们不是一起睡了吗？”

小罗一边用床帘擦手，一边笑着回答。

TRAITORS IN WENSHUI SEARCH FOR WOMEN

(Letter from Sian)

We used to express our doubt over newspaper
reports of acts of atrocity, such as rape and ravish by
Japanese soldiers. A reporter recently obtained from a
refugee from Shensi a document proving Japanese oppression
of women with the aid of traitors. The text of that

"Order No.1, character Tsah, of Wenshui Hsien(文水縣)
Administration to the village chief of Nanyien Tsung Village.

"Since the establishment of the brothel in the
Wu Chia Hong Alleyway in the city, the inhabitants have been
living in peace. Now it has been found that all the
prostitutes in the brothel have contracted venereal disease
except four.

"By order of the Imperial Army, the number of
prostitutes must be increased within three days. Every
village of more than 300 families must provide one prostitute.
She must be about 20 years of age, healthy, and beautiful.
They should first be sent to the Hsien Administration for
examination.

"Every month each girl will receive from the
Maintenance Association 50 catties of heroin, 5 pints of
rye, 2 catties of kerosene oil, and more than 100 catties
of black coal and also one dollar. In addition, all
donations from patrons are to be paid to the prostitutes."

Part 68.

THE FIFTH NIGHT

Chow Hsao Hu kissed her and said, "you are quite
pitiable, I will do that you request". He then turned off
the light. Street lamps casted a dim light into the room
and he saw indistinctly that she was taking off her outer
gown. Next, she sat on the bed to remove everything from
her body. After a moment, he knew that she became a
"naked chicken", and he approached her.

When she knew that he was near her, her breathing
began quicker. "You stand where you are", she said; then
she stretched her both hands and felt all over his body.
When she touched that part of his body, she said, "you are
as tall as you were last year, why does this thing change so
quickly, it is different from last night?".

Chow said, "Don't talk nonsense, you always try
to find some excuse, I just saw your legs put in a suitable
position, and now you again bring your two legs together
leaving not a single space for me, this means you try to
evade, I have no time to speak to you any more".

"I don't evade," she replied hastily, "you may
feel me with your hands and you will know it; I say, you
can measure from my lower abdomen to my back bone, the
length of it (vagina) is not longer than 2 inches, but
yours (penis) is far more than 2 inches in height, how
can it be possible".

Chow Hsao Hu said, "I don't want to talk physiology
with you, any woman in the world could hold it. Don't worry
about it, I will buy a pair of high heel-shoes for you to-
morrow, then, when you walk awkwardly to-morrow after to-
night's event, nobody will be able to detect your secret
because you wear that high-heel shoes".

第六十八部分。

第五夜

周少虎吻了她，说道：“你真可怜，我会答应你的请求。”随后他关掉了灯。街灯将微弱的光线投射进房间，他模糊地看到她正在脱下外衣。接着，她坐在床上褪去身上所有衣物。片刻之后，他知道她已成了一只“白斩鸡”，便向她靠近。

当她察觉他靠近时，呼吸开始急促起来。“你就站在那儿，”她说；然后她伸出双手，抚摸他的全身。当她的手触碰到他身体的那个部位时，她说：“你和去年一样高，为什么这东西变化这么快，和昨晚不一样？”

周说：“别胡说八道，你总是找借口，我刚才看到你的双腿摆好了合适的位置，现在你又把两条腿并拢，不留一点空隙给我，这意味着你想逃避，我没时间再和你说话了。”

“我没有逃避，”她急忙回答，“你可以用手摸摸就知道了；我说，你可以量一下从我下腹部到脊椎骨的长度，它（阴道）的长度不超过两英寸，而你的（阴茎）高度远超过两英寸，这怎么可能呢。”

周少虎说：“我不想和你谈生理学，世上任何女人都能容纳它。别担心，我明天给你买一双高跟鞋，那么，在今晚的事之后，明天你走路姿势别扭时，没人能发现你的秘密，因为你穿着那双高跟鞋。”

When she heard that he would buy high-heel
shoes for her, she felt so happy that she relaxed
everything from hands to legs.

At this very moment, Chow Hsao Hu thought it
was time to enter, and all of a sudden, she was being
probed and was raised half a foot upward.

Ah Hsiang tried to scream, but Chow Hsao Hu
promptly covered her mouth with his hand. After a while,
Ah Hsiang's head turned from Chow's chest and it seemed
flexible without bones. She closed her eyes. The face
of a shy maiden appeared distinctly in the dim street
lights.

Chow smiled and said, "if your face were an
apple, I would swallow it up", She winked at him and smiled,
then closed her eyes again.

听到他要给她买高跟鞋，她感到非常高兴，手脚都放松了下来。

就在此刻，周少虎认为时机已到，可以进入，突然之间，她被侵入，身体向上抬起了半尺。

阿香试图尖叫，但周少虎迅速用手捂住了她的嘴。过了一会儿，阿香的头从周的胸前转开，似乎柔软无骨。她闭上了眼睛。在昏暗的街灯下，一位羞涩少女的面容清晰可见。

周微笑着说：“如果你的脸是一个苹果，我会把它吞下去。”她向他眨了眨眼，笑了笑，然后又闭上了眼睛。
